By leveraging NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can retain far more of their earnings while achieving true ownership of their sales infrastructure.

content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Selling digital products directly to consumers without relying on conventional payment platforms means overcoming significant barriers, particularly in emerging markets. This architecture provides a solution that eliminates high transaction fees and dependency on third-party platforms. For instance, while Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, using NOWPayments only incurs a 0.5% fee, allowing creators to keep more of their revenue. This shift in infrastructure empowers creators by giving them full control over their sales process and eliminating the risk of payment rejections or account freezes.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several key components: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, a robust database like Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. This setup allows for automated delivery of digital products immediately after payment confirmation. When a customer purchases an ebook or template, the entire process—from payment to product delivery—is seamless and efficient, ensuring that creators can focus on their content rather than the complexities of payment processing.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators operating in regions where mainstream payment platforms have failed. Artists, educators, and entrepreneurs in countries like Ghana, Kenya, and Ethiopia can now reach global customers without being hindered by local financial restrictions. By adopting this architecture, they can sell digital products—such as courses, fonts, and software—directly to their audience, while enjoying the advantages of lower fees and full ownership of their sales data.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% fees, unlike traditional platforms that can take up to 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this system include free hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which serve as the backbone for product delivery. Coupled with backend logic handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, these tools create an efficient framework for managing sales and customer interactions. NOWPayments seamlessly integrates with this architecture, allowing for real-time cryptocurrency transactions. This combination empowers creators to operate independently, providing a complete system that does not rely on traditional payment gateways.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first, select a digital product you wish to sell, such as an ebook or a course. Next, sign up for a NOWPayments account to handle your cryptocurrency transactions. Choose a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to set up your store. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend functionality, and connect your product storage through Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, configure your systems for automatic delivery and start marketing your digital products. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Deploying your digital store means complete ownership and control over your sales process.

If you’re looking to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all necessary blueprints and templates to establish your own sovereign digital commerce stack, offering everything needed to succeed in selling digital products autonomously.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify the digital products you want to sell. Create an account with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Choose a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, for your store. Implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up a database with Supabase or Google Sheets to manage orders. Configure your systems for automatic product delivery and start promoting your offerings.
